title: Prompt Middleware Chain
instructions: Build `pipeline.py` as a Chain of Responsibility. Define the `Request` dataclass and the frozen slotted `Response`, then write `build_chain(middlewares, endpoint)` so the first middleware is outermost, plus `tracing(name)`, `require_user` (401) and `max_prompt_chars(limit)` (413). Middlewares may short-circuit, the chain must be reusable, and every layer must keep its own `next` (no late-binding closures).

evidence.label: Request has a per-instance trace and Response is frozen with slots
A short-circuit skips inner layers and the endpoint
Many layers each call their own next (no late binding)
An empty chain behaves like the endpoint
A built chain can be called repeatedly
Middleware can act on the response on the way out
require_user and max_prompt_chars handle their boundaries
build_chain accepts any sequence and does not mutate it
